Definition: to set in a row, i.e. arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to arrange, set or put or lay in order, set in array, prepare, order, ordain, handle, furnish, esteem, equal, direct, compare; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to arrange or set or lay in order, arrange, state in order, set forth (a legal case), set in place; 1a2) to compare, be comparable; 2) (Hiphil) to value, tax
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
